red.evidence: Real file reader and lifecycle threads remained blocked after join in disable/remove/upgrade/ledger-revocation probes. Both permission/reset gates reached; no worker exceptions.

rejected_candidate.reason: Conditional deferred reset allowed stale state to revive after reenable or external-ledger reapproval.
rejected_candidate.disposition: Replaced after independent review; never merged or released.

change: Separate lifecycle RLock serializes complete refresh/mutations/invalidation. Metadata and permission checks keep the manager lock; file reset runs after releasing it. Initial full refresh invalidates external revocation before new approval. Program reset position and FileAccessService source unchanged.
coverage: Concurrent pending clarification versus disable/remove/upgrade/approval ledger removal, with actual locks and persisted records.
Reactivation waits for old invalidation; a fresh request survives; no-fresh pending and real listed/selected result cannot revive.
Sequential missing-ledger reapproval clears old actual selection/token.
Permission callback waits for revocation metadata transaction; per-operation limits and descriptor copies preserved.
Unrelated refresh retains active pending request, token and policy; test-owned data preserved.
substitutions: Event-controlled callback boundaries only; manager, file service, RLocks and temporary files real.
Deadlock probes run in isolated child processes using daemon worker threads so a regression cannot hang the suite.
No account, microphone, GGUF, user profile or installed Jarvis exercised.
